# Third-party libraries

These files are copied unchanged from npm so the site works without loading anything from other websites.

- `marked.min.js`: marked 15 (Markdown to HTML), MIT licence, https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `fonts/`: KaTeX 0.16 (maths), MIT licence, https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
- `purify.min.js`: DOMPurify 3 (keeps the HTML safe), Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0, https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
